units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25:5">Lev. R. s. 25</cite> <he>זיל עֲדוֹר וכ׳</he> go and pick in thy own dunghill; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 925">Yalk. Job 925</cite>.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="P00163">same</cite>. Lev. R. l. c. <he>ומְעַדְּרָה קדמיהון</he> (not <he>ומעדרנה</he>) and she (the mother) picks for them; Yalk. l. c. (not <he>ומעררה</he>).
